lines.en: I streak past as a purple blur
This young body flies faster

lines.zh: 我压低身子贴着屋顶掠过
lines.en: I skim low over the rooftops
The air bursts open behind me
My cape pulls taut

lines.zh: 两米六的高度，我俯视一切
lines.en: Two and a half blocks tall, I look down on all
One stride carries me across a street

lines.zh: 我加速时连风都追不上
lines.en: When I accelerate, even the wind falls behind
My feet never touch the ground

lines.zh: 我拐了个急弯，袍子翻起
lines.en: I bank hard and my robe flares
I stand straight, hands behind my back

lines.zh: 这一身年轻的力量压不住
lines.en: This youthful power will not be contained
I sweep my eyes across the surroundings

lines.zh: 年轻的魔王不需要休息
lines.en: A young Demon King needs no rest
My ki pulses beneath my skin
I tense my fingers and release them

lines.zh: 脚下的影子比去年短了
lines.en: My shadow is shorter than last year's

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得出手的人
lines.en: I am waiting for someone worth striking
The wind moves the edge of my cape
I lift my head, the sky is clean

lines.zh: 我的呼吸一次比一次深
lines.en: My breathing grows deeper each time

lines.zh: 这副身体正是最好的年纪
lines.en: This body is at its best age
I sink my ki a little lower

lines.zh: 年轻的身体连静止都在蓄力
lines.en: Even at rest this young body gathers power
I look at my own palm
You are shorter than I expected
Speak looking up, I do not bend down
The young me has a poor temper
I look down at you without hiding it
You have nerve, but not strength

lines.zh: 我这一身力量还在往上走
lines.en: My strength is still climbing

lines.zh: 你想从我这里得到什么
lines.en: What do you want from me

lines.zh: 我们之间差着一整个时代
lines.en: A whole era stands between us
I hold my chin very high
Do not let your hands shake, it is ugly

lines.zh: 我笑的时候你也该害怕
lines.en: You should be afraid when I smile
The blow knocked my head aside

lines.zh: 这一下让我后退了一步
lines.en: That one pushed me back a step
Pain is sharper when you are young

lines.zh: 我咬牙把这口气吞下去
lines.en: I grit my teeth and swallow it
A corner of my cape is torn
Blood runs down, I cannot be bothered to wipe it
You hit me, once
My ki scatters for half a breath.
This blow is worth remembering

lines.zh: 你以为我会为这个停下来
lines.en: You think I would stop for this

lines.zh: 年轻的魔王不缺口吃的
lines.en: A young Demon King lacks no food

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼就没兴趣了
lines.en: One glance and I lost interest

lines.zh: 你把它举得那么高，给谁看
lines.en: Who are you showing that to
My strength does not depend on eating
Take it away, do not waste my time

lines.zh: 这点东西连哄孩子都不够
lines.en: This would not even coax a child
I did not even reach out
You seem to have the wrong target
I have no patience for this
You hit me like hitting a wall
I did not budge, you did
That much momentum, I cannot be bothered

lines.zh: 我的披风被你踩了一角
lines.en: You stepped on a corner of my cape

lines.zh: 别用身体试探我的脾气
lines.en: Do not test my temper with your body
I brushed you half a block aside
I am young, but my bones are hard
You should be apologizing after that

lines.zh: 我的高度让你不好受吧
lines.en: My height is uncomfortable for you, is it not
Steady yourself, do not fall at my feet
You should not ask me that
My time is for growing stronger
A Demon King has no room for that
I have never even considered it
My bloodline will carry itself on
You are prying too much
I need no one to keep me company

lines.zh: 别拿这个浪费我的耐性
lines.en: Do not waste my patience on this

lines.zh: 我的目光从不落在这些事上
lines.en: My gaze never falls on such matters
This ends right here
Two fingers are enough.

lines.zh: 这东西对我没有任何意义
lines.en: This means nothing to me
I glance at it and toss it away

lines.zh: 地上有什么值得我弯腰
lines.en: What on the ground is worth bending for
I squeeze it out of shape
My fingers are far harder than this
This weight, I do not care
I tuck it into my sleeve, it may be useful

lines.zh: 这片废墟里没什么好东西
lines.en: There is nothing good in these ruins
I step on it and it breaks
You finally dared to step out
I have waited too long for this
My hands itch for this fight
My ki is already at its limit
I have your position memorized
Come on, do not dawdle
I raise my hand and my palm glows

lines.zh: 年轻的力气总要找地方用
lines.en: Young strength always needs somewhere to go
I see every step you take
This sky is under my control

lines.zh: 你的速度在我眼里很慢
lines.en: Your speed looks slow to me
I lower my weight and the airflow drops
Do not think I will hold back
I intend to be serious with this one
You will not be the first

lines.zh: 我从不给对手第二次机会
lines.en: I never give an opponent a second chance

lines.zh: 我的袍角已经飘起来了
lines.en: My robe hem is already lifting
The moment I waited for is here
I circle above your head

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候就输了
lines.en: The moment you look up, you lose
My ki blasts are lined up at my fingers
I show a gap on purpose
You cannot reach my height
I am waiting for your ki to break
Every step you retreat, I close in
My ki tightens around you
I do not need to land
Your breathing grows heavier
I bring both hands together
This whole airspace is mine
If you do not move, I move first

lines.zh: 我算准了你的跳跃高度
lines.en: I have measured your jump height
The ki inside you is falling
I wait for your second mistake
I gather my ki into a single point
You are already in my range

lines.zh: 我蓄气突击，撞穿你的防线
lines.en: I charge in and burst through your guard
Four hits, one continuous flow

lines.zh: 气弹连射压住你的脚步
lines.en: A volley of ki blasts pins your feet
Small ki blasts chase along the ground
I slap a palm into your back
A ki laser pierces the gap
My young fists are quicker than the wind

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂往上一提
lines.en: I seize your arm and haul you up
This kick comes from below

lines.zh: 最后一击我用上了全力
lines.en: I put everything into the final blow
You will not get to block the second
The aerial combo never breaks

lines.zh: 我的气顺着拳头灌进去
lines.en: My ki pours through my fist
I kick him off the ground

lines.zh: 我落地的气流掀翻了草
lines.en: My landing blast flattens the grass

lines.zh: 这一身年轻的力气回来了
lines.en: This young strength has returned
I am taller than last time

lines.zh: 我的影子先压在你身上
lines.en: My shadow falls over you first
I tear an opening in the sky
The face under the hat brim is young
I plant my feet and will not yield
Give me a little room

lines.zh: 我的气让周围安静下来
lines.en: My ki quiets everything around me

lines.zh: 三百年的名号，配一副新身体
lines.en: Three hundred years of name, in a fresh body
I land without a sound
This generation must remember me
I throw my cape behind me
I look down over this ground
The stage is mine alone again

lines.zh: 我的年纪正好，力气正好
lines.en: My age is right, my strength is right
The air all around is retreating
First let me see your strength

lines.zh: 我抬手整理了一下帽子
lines.en: I reach up and straighten my hat
This time I do not plan to hold back

lines.zh: 火贴着我的披风烧上来
lines.en: Fire climbs my cape

lines.zh: 我被砸下空中，撞进土里
lines.en: I was smashed out of the air into the dirt

lines.zh: 水压着我的胸口，喘不上气
lines.en: The water presses my chest, I cannot breathe

lines.zh: 冲击波把我的气吹散了
lines.en: The shockwave blew my ki apart
A shot struck my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股术力咬住了我的骨头
lines.en: That magic bit into my bones

lines.zh: 我太久没吃东西，气在退
lines.en: I have not eaten in too long, my ki recedes

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的身体走了一遍
lines.en: Lightning ran the length of my body

lines.zh: 我掉进一片什么都没有的地方
lines.en: I fell into a place with nothing at all
